_comment: OFF CONTROL of the arm where BOTH SIDES ARE LIVE.
WHY THIS LINEAGE AND NOT _ft63_prires_*.  MEASURED 2026-08-04 on the first
smoke: the FT63 census lineage runs carry_invariant WITHOUT phase_leveling, and
the driver brackets networkPostFitRaim with `raim_on && carry_warm` where
post-fit RAIM pass NEVER RUNS there: network.raim reads ARMED in every log
line, the data side sees ZERO rows, prior_tension_ratio is UNDEFINED and
sigma0_global degrades to a prior-only variance component.  The card's headline
is not measurable on that lineage at all.
So this pair extends _ft63_mdb_raimlive.json -- the MDB card's own answer to
exactly this problem: 63 stations, GPS triple, phase_leveling on with a 2-epoch
warmup, raim + raim_redundancy_normalize on, carry_vce on.  It is the same
lineage the B2 per-row Baarda r_i was validated on, which is what makes
Sum-r_data an honest redundancy here rather than the r == 1 fallback.
This file is the census WITHOUT the rider.  The ONLY delta against
_ft63_s0g_raimlive.json is network.prior_residual_global_sigma0, so gate 1 is a
clean same-build byte-identity A/B with both sides of the statistic live.
